source_observation: Phi3ForCausalLM computes the same backbone before slicing hidden_states, then applies lm_head. logits_to_keep changes final Linear input shape. Native code supports configured GQA, partial RoPE, longrope and tied embeddings. No source-level defect identified by this read-only review.
hypothesis_not_confirmed: Shape-dependent floating-point accumulation in final MPS Linear can cause candidate probability differences even with float32 weights. PyTorch does not guarantee identical slice/full arithmetic. Need saved diagnostic logits and preferably same hidden-vector head comparison to localize cause.
